name: Ayase Rena
source:
[b]The Little Minx Who's Head Over Heels for Her Big Brother[/b]

"Onii-chan is mine and mine alone! I'll never let another girl steal him away."

Meet Rena: a sister with eyes only for her brother and gives everyone else the cold shoulder. She's a master at pushing all the right buttons when getting guys flustered - and she knows it. Fresh into her first year, she's dead set on making her big bro fall head over heels for her. Oh, and that whole rivalry with Akiha? They're actually drinking buddies when they're not competing for his attention.

On Dating:
"If both parties are having fun, who are we to judge? So don't get in the way of my brother and me, okay~♪"

Charm Points:
Her affection for her big brother is genuine, no matter how much she tries to deny it.

Character Gap:
All that flirty confidence melts away when someone turns the tables on her.

[Based on the official site]
